# EDIT THESE SETTINGS. Paths use forward slashes on Windows.
# ```{r}
# workflow_folder <- 'code'
# source(file.path(workflow_folder, '../code/common.R'))
# band_dir <- '../data/060220/'
# output_dir <- '../output/060220_extracted/'
# dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
# ```

```{r}
# Choose a drive with plenty of free disk space
raster_temp <- "D:/R_terra_temp"

dir.create(raster_temp, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

terra::terraOptions(
  tempdir = raster_temp,
  memfrac = 0.5
)

# Check where temporary rasters will be stored
terra::terraOptions()
```


```{r}
# Load common.R from the current code folder
source("common.R")

# Go up one level to access data and output
band_dir <- "../data/082520"
output_dir <- "../output/082520_extracted"

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Keys are important: use 're' for red-edge, not 'rededge'.
# Parrot Sequoia/no-blue imagery: DELETE the blue line; do not create a fake band.
# Use your actual processed REFLECTANCE orthomosaic filenames.
```{r}
band_paths <- c(
  green = file.path(band_dir, "08_25_20_transparent_reflectance_green.tif"),
  red   = file.path(band_dir, "08_25_20_transparent_reflectance_red.tif"),
  re    = file.path(band_dir, "08_25_20_transparent_reflectance_red edge.tif"),
  nir   = file.path(band_dir, "08_25_20_transparent_reflectance_nir.tif")
)
# blue  = file.path(band_dir, 'blue.tif')
```

# Set from export metadata: 1 for reflectance 0-1; 10000 if scaled by 10000.
# Do not infer the divisor solely from an image's maximum value.
```{r}
reflectance_divisor <- 1
align_bands <- FALSE
plant_threshold <- 0.4 # starting value only: inspect soil, shadows and leaf edges
plots_file <- NULL # optional: 'C:/your/path/Ponder_shape_projected.shp'
plot_id <- 'plot' # exact column name in polygon attributes
```


```{r}
stack_path <- file.path(output_dir, 'reflectance_stack.tif')
stack <- build_stack(band_paths, stack_path, reflectance_divisor, align_bands)
# Normalize explicitly above; disable package automatic rescaling.
imp <- ppe_import(stack_path, ortho_type = 'ms',
                  band_names = setNames(seq_along(band_paths), names(band_paths)),
                  normalize = 'false', outfile = file.path(output_dir, 'ppe_work'))
result <- run_ppe(imp, stack, output_dir, plant_threshold, plots_file, plot_id)
```

# result$plant_tiff is the file to open in QGIS or copy/share.
# R exports it to disk; it does not need to be downloaded from an online service.
